h:
我尝试利用 SUPIR 进行简单的升级工作流程。创建此工作流程的最初目的是恢复家庭照片，但它根本不限于该用例。可以补充ComfyUI Fooocus Inpaint 工作流程用于纠正任何小瑕疵。 （该模型展示的所有图像都没有经过修饰，以便准确地显示其作为独立过程的功能。）

我目前对与此工作流程一起使用的检查点的偏好是HelloWorld XL v7对于升级模型4xRealWebPhoto v4 DAT2或4x 超锋利.

根据我自己的使用情况，此工作流程应该能够在预设设置的 8GB vram 上运行。如果您有功能强大的硬件，则需要考虑一些其他设置注意事项：

  • 尝试在 SUPIR 模型加载器上禁用 fp8_unet 和/或启用高 vram。

  • 在 SUPIR 采样器中，您可能需要启用 keep_model_loaded （特别是如果您不打算在下游加载更多模型而需要为其释放 vram）。

  • 您还可以绕过放大组中的缩小步骤（图像调整大小节点）。

我建议使用ComfyUI管理器用于安装和更新工作流程中使用的任何其他自定义节点。

o.en:
My attempt at a straightforward upscaling workflow utilizing SUPIR. This workflow was created with the initial intent of restoring family photos, but it is not at all limited to that use case. Can be complemented withComfyUI Fooocus Inpaint Workflowfor correcting any minor artifacts. (None of the images showcased for this model are touched up so as to accurately display its capabilities as a standalone process.)

My current preference for checkpoint to use with this workflow isHelloWorld XL v7and for upscaling model either4xRealWebPhoto v4 DAT2or4xUltrasharp.

Based on my own usage this workflow should be able to run on 8gb of vram on the preset settings. Some additional setting considerations if you have capable hardware:

  • Experiment with disabling fp8_unet and/or enabling high vram on the SUPIR model loader.

  • In the SUPIR sampler you'll likely want to enable keep_model_loaded (especially if you don't plan to load more models downstream needing to free up vram for them).

  • You can also bypass the downscaling step (image resize node) in the upscale group.

I'd recommend usingComfyUI-Managerfor installing and updating any other custom nodes used within the workflow.
